launch.mode: visible isolated private Xvfb X11; fresh HOME/XDG/profile for each process
launch.focusPolicy: No bringToFront, daily-window activation, minimization, or desktop scan
launch.cdp: Short-lived loopback endpoint gated to owned PID/UID/startTicks/argv/exe
launch.network: Localhost origin/path GET allowlist + CSP + intercepted target requests; memory GM blocks all provider requests

harnessRevisionBoundary: For the first SVG sample, the complete helper-file version was not measured before import. An unused parameter-construction export was added around that run. The observation-expression and page-side observer function bodies were byte-identical across all three reconstructed versions, retained locally. Later two samples also checked the complete helper hash before/after. This does not infer the first process imported whole-file SHA from current disk state.
limits: These are userscript memory-GM tests, not extension incognito tests
Detached real Vue SVG DOM attributes were tested; pixels/raster/layout were not compared
Cold intervals exclude browser-process startup; OS/V8/disk-cache coldness was not established
Standard light settings and standalone full Options differ; timings do not rank same-feature performance
SVG observer has unquantified API-wrapper/timer overhead; bytes materialization and actual inflate are measured together; zero is below observed clock precision
No uncompressed browser control, RSS or throughput comparison
Tldts warm replay uses actual captured inflate but replayed constructors; actual seven exports and 22 parser vectors are independent functional checks
Extension incognito, real provider/model/search APIs, native GNOME Wayland/Cua, real RTX5090 WebGPU, whole repository suite and coverage remain unrun
Complete local browser harness and private logs/profiles are not published; summary includes exact local evidence hashes
